requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3220-3249-4549--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Golgari Germination triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1170-2981-5131-5705--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2981-5131-5705--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

64-1987-2427.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
64-1987-2427.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-2427.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1619-4605-5542-5686-6147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6147.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rilsa Rael from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Rilsa Rael.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Rilsa Rael token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Rilsa Rael trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6147.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

240-643-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Maskwood Nexus, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-643-2292.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

2292-5170-6132-7452.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2049-3259-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2049-3259-7296.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

765-1257-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
765-1257-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3000-5929-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog by paying {G}{U}
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the creature token enters as a Mutant due to Leyline of Transformation, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Chatterfang.
Repeat step 3.
3000-5929-7304.notes: Step 3 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

2510-4217-7300.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-4217-7300.description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Semblance Anvil.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat from step 3.

2511-6662-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-4288-5414.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4288-5414.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

876-2906-7070.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
876-2906-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat.

2034-5220-5447.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
2034-5220-5447.notablePrerequisites: You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
2034-5220-5447.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5147-6872--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5147-6872--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a persist creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Long Feng trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other persist creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

225-539-765-872.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaled Herbalist as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

907-1825-6760.notablePrerequisites:
Selesnya Sanctuary and up to three other lands you control can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{W}.
Adagia has twelve or more charge counters on it.
907-1825-6760.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary and up to three other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}.
Activate Adagia by paying {3}{W} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Treachery that is legendary attached to any creature.
If you control two legendary Treachery permanents, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Treachery token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, untapping Adagia, Selesnya Sanctuary and up to three other lands.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

198-864-4067-6281.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Eternal Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Eternal Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

1445-4871-5147-5632.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5147-5632.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student // Tamiyo, Seasoned Scholar

708-3927-4050-6223.description:
Cast Myth Unbound by paying {2}{G}.
Cast Sakashima's Protege by paying {4}{U}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Myth Unbound.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tamiyo, adding {U}.
Choose to return Tamiyo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Sakashima's Protege trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Tamiyo from the command zone by paying {U}.
Repeat from step 3.

372-2239-2417.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Ardent Elementalist exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
372-2239-2417.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Ardent Elementalist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Ardent Elementalist trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Ardent Elementalist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1238-2351-5231-5467-5929.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Repeat.

2713-4038-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Farmstead Gleaner.
Farmstead Gleaner does not have summoning sickness.
2713-4038-4474.description:
Activate Farmstead Gleaner's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner's own ability by paying {1} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Farmstead Gleaner.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

396-3652-4050-5222.notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Realms attached to Ornithopter.
396-3652-4050-5222.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {1}.
When Ornithopter dies, Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Ornithopter to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Unicorn, adding {W}.
Activate Sword of the Realms' equip ability by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ornithopter.
Repeat.

643-1424-1791-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
643-1424-1791-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
The Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Kyler, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

2585-4241-4893.notablePrerequisites: Grim Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
2585-4241-4893.description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Grim Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Grim Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat step 1 and 3.

579-1912-2713-3883-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {U}, causing an opponent to draw a card.
Hullbreacher replaces the card drawn with you creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it to add {U}{U}.
Repeat.

413-567-1981.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-567-1981.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Soul's Attendant trigger.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
